summary.headline: Scheduled update-ring behavior controls removed
summary.summary: The reference removes Automatic behavior frequency, Scheduled install day, and Scheduled install time from its automatic update behavior guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Check the current policy surface before relying on scheduled installation controls.

summary.headline: Driver update reports article refreshed
summary.summary: The article date is updated to January 12, 2026 and the User permissions to use reports heading is removed.
summary.adminImpact: Review current driver update reporting permissions guidance.

summary.headline: Update ring policy reference spacing adjusted
summary.summary: The patch adds a blockquote spacer in the policy settings article.

summary.headline: Android Settings Catalog management-mode filtering clarified
summary.summary: The article explains that selecting two or more Android management modes displays settings that apply to at least one selected mode.
summary.adminImpact: Expect an inclusive union of applicable settings when filtering multiple Android management modes.

summary.headline: Driver updates article removes commented legacy overview
summary.summary: A commented legacy introduction explaining approvals, pauses, and recommended versus optional drivers is removed.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current active article text for driver update guidance.

summary.headline: Feature update policy article replaces reporting section with co-management considerations
summary.summary: The Validation and reporting section is removed and a Co-management considerations section is introduced.
summary.adminImpact: Evaluate co-management implications when assigning feature update policies.

summary.headline: Feature updates article removes commented legacy introduction
summary.summary: A commented legacy description about holding devices at a specific feature update version is removed.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current active feature update management guidance.

summary.headline: Feature update policy adds migration guidance from update-ring deferrals
summary.summary: The article recommends ending update-ring deferrals when using feature update policies because combining them can delay installation; user-experience settings can remain.
summary.adminImpact: Remove feature deferrals from update rings when moving to feature update policies, while retaining desired user-experience settings.

summary.headline: Automatic update behavior formatting changed to heading
summary.summary: Automatic update behavior changes from a bold label to a level-five heading.

summary.headline: Automatic update behavior formatting reverted
summary.summary: Automatic update behavior changes back from a level-five heading to a bold label and the EDU Restart heading is adjusted.
